queries:
SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / 4581 AS share
FROM inventory
GROUP BY film_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT f.title, i.store_id, COUNT(*) AS copies, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory) AS share_of_total_inventory
FROM inventory i
JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
GROUP BY i.film_id, i.store_id
ORDER BY copies DESC, f.title, i.store_id
LIMIT 10

SELECT f.rating, COUNT(i.inventory_id) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory) AS share_of_copies
FROM inventory i
JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
GROUP BY f.rating;

SELECT store_id,
       COUNT(*) AS copies,
       CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT film_id) FROM inventory) AS share
FROM inventory
GROUP BY store_id;
